answer: Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 79 aliases, and each one needs its own funded quill account. Deposits are visible in lantern, and whisper reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 40% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 351 aliases cost 73 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
